description: Measured medians and correctness checks; raw per-sample evidence is in the external download bundle. No full-model benchmark.

method.mode: eager, autograd-enabled forward; no CUDA Graph replay
method.included: validation, allocations, wrappers, backward stable sort and zero fill
method.backward: prebuilt retained graph; sorting repeated on each backward
method.wall_ms: host dispatch plus execution and end synchronization
method.event_ms: CUDA events around the complete call, including device idle dispatch gaps
method.reference: CPU FP64 index_add accuracy oracle, not timed
method.comparison: all elements; shared WS1 gradient_accuracy/reduction thresholds
method.selection: synthetic half-row selection at H3 mixed-row counts and head widths
